name: Egret Payroll
tagline: The payroll department every independent filmmaker was promised but never had.
positioning: Egret runs film payroll, taxes, and crew paperwork for the solo producer — the same machinery that used to require a studio accounting floor.

hero.h1: Cut the check as cleanly as you cut the film.
hero.sub: Egret turns timecards, deal memos, and 1099s into a single pay run you finish before lunch. Fund your crew, file your taxes, and keep every penny audit-ready — no accountant on retainer required.

features.title: Timecards that survive set
features.description: Crew clock in from their phones, meal penalties calculate themselves, and daily rates roll up into a pay run without a single spreadsheet formula.

features.title: Same-day crew payments
features.description: Approve a run and the gaffer, DP, and PAs are paid the same afternoon — direct deposit for W-2 crew, instant transfer for 1099 vendors.

features.title: Taxes filed while you sleep
features.description: Egret withholds, remits, and files federal, state, and local payroll taxes automatically, then hands you the year-end W-2s and 1099s already sealed.

features.title: Deal memos, done right
features.description: Send a start packet, collect signed I-9s and W-4s, and lock in each person's rate, kit fee, and box rental before day one of shooting.

features.title: Multi-state, one shoot
features.description: Chase a location to three states in a week and Egret tracks residency, reciprocity, and incentive-eligible wages for every day of the schedule.

features.title: An audit binder on demand
features.description: Every rate, receipt, and remittance is filed the moment it happens, so your production accounting is closed before the film is even color-graded.

testimonials.quote: I used to spend the last week of every shoot terrified of the payroll math. With Egret I approved a run for eleven crew from my hotel and the taxes just filed themselves. It felt like having a production accountant I couldn't afford.
testimonials.name: Renata Alvarez

testimonials.quote: We shot a documentary across four states with a rotating crew of freelancers. Egret handled every residency rule and had the 1099s ready in January without me touching a form.
testimonials.name: Desmond Okafor

testimonials.quote: My AD, my grips, and my composer all get paid differently, and Egret finally makes that a two-minute job instead of a two-day panic. It pays for itself on the first shoot day.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatesan
